description: This file defines the 'Home' page component for a notes application. It structures the layout with header, notes list, and editor pane, handles user interactions like selecting, creating, and updating notes, and responds to global events related to notes.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main component representing the home page of the notes application with header, notes list, and editor pane.

methods.name: $handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note from the NotesList component and updates the current selected note.

methods.name: $handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note from the NotesList component and sets it as selected.
